Oliver — thanks for waiting while we reviewed internally. Below is our formal proposal and actionable checklist so AP can onboard quickly. This message summarizes the DocuSign amendment we'll send once you confirm.

Proposal (summary):
- Standard terms: Net45 (invoices issued on the 5th each month for prior-month consumption).
- Temporary concession: Net60 for the Apr–Jun 2026 billing window for months where Mediserv provides a PO that references the MSA and confirms the VAT routing. Net60 is conditional and will be applied on a per-month basis after AP submits the PO.
- Credit ceiling: $125,000 of gross exposure for 90 days commencing on the first invoice under this arrangement; review after 90 days against actual consumption.
- VAT routing: Redwood will route invoices to Mediserv Netherlands BV (NL entity) and apply reverse-charge only after we receive the VAT registration certificate and a signed Invoice Routing Addendum. If documents are not provided within 14 days of the first invoice date, invoices will default to Mediserv UK Ltd and standard VAT will apply.
- Contingency: 10% reserve withhold if VAT documentation is missing at invoice time; clause allowing Redwood to request advance payment or reduce cap if monthly utilization > 130% of forecast.

Action items for Mediserv AP (to reply to this thread and attach the docs):
1) PO referencing Redwood MSA and noting "Net60 request subject to conditional credit approval" (one PO per month when Net60 is requested).
2) VAT registration certificate for Mediserv Netherlands BV (PDF).
3) Signed Invoice Routing Addendum (we'll send via DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/1234abc

Attachments included: Signed_MSA_v2.pdf, Invoice_Schedule_Proposal.xlsx (sample cadence). We'll also upload the DocuSign amendment to HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7682) once you confirm.

If this works, Priyom will coordinate the amendment and Kimberly will issue the one-time credit cap release notice. If you prefer a quick call to sign off we can schedule today.
